method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 5 of 5 breaks heard

lines.latin: Ave María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum,
lines.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee;

lines.latin: et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Jesus.
lines.english: and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

lines.latin: nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
lines.english: now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
